post.description: Discover nearby Pizza Hut stores and their store numbers, addresses, hours and supported occasions.

address.description: Street address to deliver to (e.g. `400 Pine St`); required with occasion DELIVERY and refused with CARRYOUT.

occasion.description:
CARRYOUT (default) finds the nearest stores to postal_code. DELIVERY finds the stores that deliver to address in postal_code and requires address.

Provider reference: allowed values ["CARRYOUT", "DELIVERY"]; default "CARRYOUT".

Find Pizza Hut US stores near a five-digit postal code for carryout, or the stores that deliver to a street address (occasion DELIVERY with address). Upstream returns the nearest stores regardless of distance: check postal_code_match, nearest_distance_miles and warnings before treating the first store as local.

The response contains the tool result directly.
